items.headline: Sacramento State beats Mississippi Valley State 52-0 for Alonzo Carter's first win as head coach
items.description: — Jackson Sharman threw four touchdown passes, three to Matt Coleman, as Sacramento State shut out FCS member Mississippi Valley State 52-0 on Saturday night, giving Alonzo Carter his first win as the Hornets’ head coach.

items.headline: Noah Kim's 3 touchdowns lead Eastern Michigan to 28-17 win over Sacramento State
items.description: — Noah Kim threw for two touchdowns and ran for another to lead Eastern Michigan past Sacramento State 28-17 in a season and Mid-American Conference opener on Saturday night.
